Inline comments: Review comments at @src/app/OperationService.cpp: - Around line 351-359: Delayed acquisitions can leave the active operation slot reserved when cancelled or when either journal save fails before acquisition starts. In the delayed branch of OperationService, retain a one-shot release callback for the unused acquisition and invoke it before each early return that occurs before acquisition begins, including both save failures and cancellation or early-error exits. Once acquisition starts, leave release handling to the countdown and adapter. Review comments at @src/platform/x11/CaptureProcessController.cpp: - Around line 104-107: Update the error-code allowlist in CaptureProcessController::receive to accept session_locked, so this helper error is handled as a valid error frame rather than a protocol failure. Include delay_unavailable only if it is an error code the helper can emit and the controller should accept. Review comments at @src/ui/MainWindow.cpp: - Line 204: Update the per-action delay-save callback in the action loop to capture the current action and pass it to showActionFailure instead of the hard-coded "region", so failures are reported against the action that initiated the save.
